lines: Bulbul ne gul se, gul ne bahaaron se keh diya.
couplets.en: The nightingale told the rose, and the rose told the spring.

lines: Bulbul ne gul se, gul ne bahaaron se keh diya.
couplets.en: The nightingale told the rose, and the rose told the spring.

lines: Ek chaudhvin ke chaand ne taaron se keh diya.
Duniya kisi ke pyaar mein jannat se kam nahin.
couplets.en: The full moon told the stars that the world, when you love someone, is every bit as fair as paradise.

lines: Duniya kisi ke pyaar mein jannat se kam nahin.
Ek dilruba hai dil mein jo hooron se kam nahin.
couplets.en: In love the world is as fair as paradise, and the beloved in my heart is as lovely as any of its maidens.

lines: Duniya kisi ke pyaar mein jannat se kam nahin.

couplets.en: In love the world is as fair as paradise, and the beloved in my heart is as lovely as any of its maidens.

lines: Bhoole se muskurao to moti baras padein.
couplets.en: A smile escapes you, and pearls come falling.

lines: Bhoole se muskurao to moti baras padein.
couplets.en: A smile escapes you, and pearls come falling.

lines: Kaliyaan bhi hans padein.
couplets.en: Even the flower buds break into laughter.

lines: Kaliyaan bhi hans padein.

lines: Kaliyaan bhi hans padein.
Khushboo tumhaari zulf ki phoolon se kam nahin.
couplets.en: Even the buds laugh, and your hair is as fragrant as any flower.

lines: Duniya kisi ke pyaar mein jannat se kam nahin.

lines: Tum baadshah-e-husn ho, husn-e-jahaan ho.
couplets.en: You reign over beauty and embody all the beauty of the world.

lines: Tum baadshah-e-husn ho, husn-e-jahaan ho.
Jaan-e-wafa ho aur mohabbat ki shaan ho.
couplets.en: You are the beauty of the world, the soul of fidelity and the grace of love.

lines: Jaan-e-wafa ho aur mohabbat ki shaan ho.
Jalwe tumhaare husn ke taaron se kam nahin.
couplets.en: You are the soul of fidelity and the grace of love, and your beauty shines as brightly as the stars.
